description_en: Retrieves the historical analysis tasks for recent and full deadlock analysis
description_zh: 获取最近死锁分析、全量死锁分析的历史分析任务列表
name: GetDeadLockHistory

parameters.help_en:
The node ID.

Specify the node ID for a PolarDB for MySQL instance
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

<notice>

This parameter is a Long value. To prevent precision loss during serialization and deserialization, make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
<notice>该字段类型为Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

<notice>

This parameter is a Long value. To prevent precision loss during serialization and deserialization, make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
<notice>该字段类型为Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The source of the task:

MANUAL or unspecified: queries tasks for recent deadlock analysis.

AUTO: queries tasks for full deadlock analysis.

<notice>

If you set this parameter to AUTO to query tasks for full deadlock analysis, the start time can be a maximum of seven days earlier than the end time.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
任务来源：
MANUAL或不传入：查询最近死锁分析任务。
AUTO：查询全量死锁分析任务。
<notice>传入AUTO查询全量死锁分析任务时，查询开始时间最大不能早于结束时间7天。></notice>
parameters.name: source

Data.description_en:
The data returned as a JSON string.

total: The total number of deadlocks.

list: The list of deadlocks.

accountId: The user ID.

textId: The text ID of the deadlock.

gmtModified: The time when the diagnostics were generated.

lockTime: The time when the deadlock occurred.

gmtCreate: The time when the diagnostics were created.

nodeId: The node ID.

uuid: The instance ID
Data.description_zh:
返回的JSON格式数据。

total: 死锁总数。
list: 死锁列表：
accountId: 用户ID。
textId: 死锁的文本ID。
gmtModified: 诊断生成时间。
lockTime: 死锁发生时间。
gmtCreate: 诊断创建时间。
nodeId: 节点ID。
uuid: 实例ID

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
